verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Sketch offering automations that run on their own in the background, whether scheduled, triggered, or recurring. The JavaScript plugin API, the `sketchtool` CLI, the `sketch://` URL scheme and the local MCP server are developer building blocks or integration points that an external client drives. The AI features, such as auto-sorting layers or replacing placeholder text, are one-off user-invoked actions, not background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
